candidates.text: Uncrewed systems contribute only when their hosts and mission pairings receive credit. Distributed scouting, deception swarms, attritable massing, and autonomous lane control address different modeled problems. Independent patrols, coordinated wolfpacks, barrier ambushes, and protective screens depend on credited force size and the modeled situation. A coordinated wolfpack with fewer than two credited undersea elements incurs coordination and escalation penalties.

Distributed scouting, deception swarms, attritable massing, and autonomous lane control answer different modeled problems; independent patrols, coordinated wolfpacks, barrier ambushes, and protective screens do the same beneath the surface. They matter only through relationships among hosts, mission pairings, credited force size, and the situation being faced. A wolfpack label cannot manufacture coordination; without two credited undersea elements, the model records coordination and escalation costs.
